turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How has your Thursday been going so far? How are things at the outpatient clinic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's been a pretty busy day, but good. I actually drove my hybrid car to the clinic today because I had some errands to run right after my shift.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, that makes sense. It's definitely convenient to have your own wheels when you have a busy to-do list. How was the traffic on your way in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It wasn't too bad, luckily! The drive actually gave me a great opportunity to start listening to that investigative true-crime show my coworker suggested a while back.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, the one about the unsolved cold cases? How are you liking it so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's really well-produced! I got so absorbed in the mystery of the first episode that the commute flew by. I'm already looking forward to the next episode.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Those kinds of shows can be incredibly addictive. Speaking of winding down, have you had any time for your sourdough baking this week, or has work kept you too occupied?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually fed my starter last night! I'm planning to bake a couple of rustic loaves this weekend if I have the energy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect weekend plan. I'm sure Tom is looking forward to some fresh bread too!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. He is always the first to grab a slice while it's still warm from the oven.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: And how is Dash doing? Is he enjoying the cooler December weather we've been having down in Tucson?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He loves it! He gets super energetic on his walks lately, though right now he's curled up in his favorite spot on the rug, fast asleep.
